objective: Assess the Pi extension entry commit b7efd82 for security vulnerabilities: process execution, wrapper and shell invocation, config and state-file parsing, and context injection into the model.
scope: The commit b7efd82 on release/0.3.0/feat/pi-extension (worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext, range 135c8c1..b7efd82) adds the Pi extension entry: a default-exported factory receiving ExtensionAPI, a --holyagent-role flag (root default, specialist, session; unknown fails closed), holyagent status on every session start reason and on session_compact plus reconcile after resume and compaction, delivered as a message via before_agent_start within the session-start budget, the Kimi root core span for session-role sessions, config loaded through the runtime loader via a config command in the shipped pi bundle, and a scripts/holyagent wrapper plus runtime bundle shipped in packages/integrations/pi/dist/scripts.

Diff without the two generated bundles: /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-ext.diff. Design docs: docs/pi/extensions.md, docs/pi/orchestration.md, docs/pi/configuration.md. Repository rules: AGENTS.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md.

Writer notes to weigh: the bundler and the hasStateFolder check were duplicated from packages/integrations/claude/src/generate.ts and packages/runtime/src/cli/hook.ts because those files were outside the writer ownership; a config command lives in hooks/pi-entry.ts instead of the CLI; sessionContext always appends the Claude reminder so piContext swaps it; docs/pi/orchestration.md still says handlers call domain functions directly; each session start runs about five short processes.

Trace sources to sinks: the role flag value, the project working directory and git toplevel, .holyagent/config.json and state files, the status and reconcile output injected as a message, the scripts/holyagent wrapper and how pi.exec builds its arguments, and the empty-bunfig.toml config used to run the bundle.
constraints: Read-only: no edits and no version-control writes; read the diff file and the worktree files.
Report in under 400 words; start each evidence line with the criterion text, a colon, then the support.

criteria.text: No command or argument injection through flag values, paths, config or state content
The wrapper runs the shipped bundle without loading project-controlled Bun config, env files or preload scripts
Injected context cannot exceed the budget or carry content beyond status, reconcile and the core span, and handler failures do not leak secrets
